title: San Francisco Transbay Terminal
scope: The December 2008 exterior of the original San Francisco Transbay Terminal at 425 Mission Street, including the granite main hall, long concrete wings and covered deck, attached viaduct ends at First and Fremont streets, and the main entrance canopy. The wider interchange, interiors, terrain of the original road surface and contemporary replacement are outside the model scope.
limitations: Roof and the immediate elevated approaches are traced approximately from the June 2009 aerial. Protected street-level edges and rear details are estimates.
Most vertical dimensions, the street elevations and exact roof equipment lack a measured section.
The current unmodified ground samples provide an approximate grade datum for the historical building. Regional viaduct ramps and interiors are outside the modeled scope.
